privacyDoc.title: Privacy policy
privacyDoc.intro: This policy explains what personal data we process on Cookivo (cookivo.pl), why, for how long, and what your rights are. We try to keep it simple - if anything is unclear, write to us. The Polish version is the binding one.

sections.title: Data controller
body: The controller of your personal data is Patryk Ożóg, who runs Cookivo as a private individual ("controller", "we").
For any matter concerning personal data, write to kontakt@cookivo.pl. We have not appointed a data protection officer - we are not required to.

sections.title: What data we process, why and on what legal basis
body: Account: username, email address, password hash (Argon2id - we never know the password itself), language and account creation date. Purpose: creating and running your account, signing in, account-related emails (address confirmation, password reset, moderation notices). Legal basis: the service contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).

Content you create: recipes, photos, ratings and comments, meal plans, pantry, shopping lists and price lists. Purpose: providing the service. Legal basis: contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). Public content is visible to all visitors, household content to its members, private content only to you.

Health data (optional): sex, date of birth, height, weight, activity, goal, allergies and intolerances. Purpose: calculating energy and macronutrient needs and filtering recipes. Legal basis: your explicit consent (Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR). You can withdraw it at any time in your profile - withdrawal deletes this data.

Household: membership, invitations (including the invitee email address if you provide it) and people without an account. Household members see your allergies and calorie target only with your separate consent. Legal basis: contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and, for health data, consent (Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR).

Friend groups (optional): membership, role, approval status, who invited you, invitations (including the invitee's email address if you provide it) and recipes shared with the group. Group members see your username and shared recipes; a person waiting for approval is visible only to the group owner. Groups give no access to health data, plans or shopping. Legal basis: contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).

Reading a recipe from photos (optional): the photos you choose in the recipe form. Purpose: reading the recipe text and filling in the form for you to check. Photos are not saved - they are deleted after reading; we only keep a usage counter (date, number of photos, result) needed for daily limits. Do not send photos containing other people’s personal data. Legal basis: contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).

Reading a receipt from photos (optional): the receipt photos you choose in the pantry or price lists. Purpose: reading the purchased products, quantities and prices for you to check before saving. Photos are not saved - they are deleted after reading; we only keep a usage counter (as for recipes). After you confirm, we save the selected products in the pantry and the prices in the price list and the price history (product, regular price, package size, shop and purchase date); in a household, its members see them. We do not save the full receipt, payment amounts or card details. Legal basis: contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).

Reading a product label from a photo (optional): the label photos (nutrition table, ingredients) you choose in the ingredient form and, optionally, the product name you typed. Purpose: reading the name, nutrition values, allergens and package weight for you to check before saving. Photos are not stored - they are deleted after reading; we only keep a usage counter. When you type the name of a new ingredient, we check whether a similar one already exists (without AI). Legal basis: contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).

Receipt product links and ingredient requests: when you confirm a receipt import, we remember which ingredient was assigned to the product name printed on the receipt in a given shop chain (e.g. "MlekoŚw3,2 1l" at Biedronka → Milk 3.2%). We suggest your assignments to you and your household, and a summary of many people's assignments to all users (without showing who bought what). Product names from a reading are kept until you confirm the import, at most one day. When you report a missing product, we store the name you give, the receipt text and the shop - the administrator sees them, and we email you when the product is added. Legal basis: contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).

General prices: regular prices from all users' confirmed receipts from the last 60 days are combined into a general product price (the median, separately for each shop chain) and shown to others in price lists and cost estimates. We do not show who bought the product or when. Price history also includes prices entered manually in a price list - these are not used for general prices. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in helping users estimate shopping costs (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR); you can object by writing to kontakt@cookivo.pl.

Assistant (optional): the text of your request and the Cookivo data needed to answer it - a list of matching recipes (titles, kcal, time, estimated cost per serving from prices), the products in your pantry and, only with consent to health data, your daily kcal target - are sent to the AI model to prepare a suggestion (a meal plan, also within a budget, a cooking plan, recipes from your pantry, a recipe version). We filter recipes for your allergies on our side - the allergies themselves are not sent for these tasks. For a substitute while cooking ("Don't have it") we send the recipe, the missing ingredient and your pantry products and, with consent to health data, the names of allergens you avoid - so that the substitute is safe for you. For a cooking plan (meal prep) we send the names of the selected recipes, their steps and the number of servings - no health data. When you dictate a shopping list, the text of the list is sent to the AI model; speech is turned into text by your browser (e.g. Chrome uses a Google service under its own terms) - recordings never reach us. The assistant does not save anything on its own: you approve the suggestions. Conversations are not stored; we only keep a usage counter (date, task type, result, tokens). Topping up the shopping list works without AI - based on the plan, the pantry and your purchase history from receipts. Legal basis: contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and, for the kcal target and allergens, your explicit consent (Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR).

Security: IP address and browser information for sign-in sessions, number of failed sign-ins and the consent history with IP address. Purpose: protecting accounts against takeover, detecting abuse and demonstrating consent. Legal basis: our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) and the duty to demonstrate consent (Art. 7(1) GDPR).

Moderation: reports about content and users, moderator decisions and account blocks with reasons. Purpose: countering illegal content and content that breaks the terms, and obligations under the Digital Services Act (DSA). Legal basis: legal obligation and legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(c) and (f) GDPR).
Correspondence: when you write to us - your email address and the message, so we can reply. Legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

Providing data is voluntary, but you cannot create an account without an email address and a password. Health data is entirely optional - the service works without it, just without health-based calculations and filters.

sections.title: Data of people without an account
body: In a household you can add a person without an account (e.g. a child) so they are included when portions are split: a name or nickname, year of birth, sex and an optional calorie target. Do this only as a parent or guardian or with that person’s consent - a nickname is enough. Only household members see this data and you can delete it at any time.

sections.title: Personalisation
body: We tailor recipe lists to your allergies, preferences and ratings (the "For me" filter and "For you" sorting). These are simple rules inside the service - we make no decisions based on them that produce legal effects for you. You can turn the filter off with a single switch.

sections.title: Who receives the data
body: We do not sell data or share it with advertisers. We only entrust it to providers without whom the service cannot run, under data processing agreements (Art. 28 GDPR):
JCHost (jchost.pl) - Polish hosting provider: application server, photos and email.

Databricks, Inc. (owner of the Neon service) - cloud database stored in the EU region (Frankfurt, Germany; Amazon Web Services infrastructure); the provider may use further sub-processors under its data processing agreement. Databricks is based in the USA - any access from outside the European Economic Area is safeguarded by the standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission (Art. 46 GDPR).

Anthropic PBC - the AI model that reads recipes, receipts and product labels from photos and powers the assistant (only when you use these features). Anthropic is based in the USA; the transfer is safeguarded by the standard contractual clauses in the data processing agreement (Art. 46 GDPR). Under Anthropic’s terms, data sent through the API is not used to train models.

When checking whether a new password has appeared in known breaches, we send the Have I Been Pwned service only the first 5 characters of the password’s SHA-1 hash - this cannot be used to recover the password or identify you.
We may also disclose data to public authorities when required by law.

sections.title: How long we keep data
body: Account and your content - until you delete the account. On deletion we erase your data, private recipes with their photos, and your ratings. Public recipes stay on the site anonymously (not linked to you) - as described in the terms.
Health data - until you withdraw consent or delete the account.
Friend group membership - until you leave the group or delete the account; after leaving, your recipes are no longer shared with the group.
Sign-in sessions (IP address, browser) - a session expires after 30 days; its data is deleted no later than 30 days after it expires or you sign out.
Links from emails (address confirmation, password reset) - one day after use or expiry.
Photos not attached to a recipe - one day.
Photos for reading a recipe, receipt or label - not kept after reading; usage counter - 90 days.
Price history from receipts - until the price list it belongs to or the account (in a household - the household) is deleted.
Receipt product links and ingredient requests - until you delete the account; product names from an unconfirmed receipt reading - one day.
Receipt prices in general prices - calculated from the last 60 days; the history entries themselves - as for price history.
Consent history - for as long as the account exists.
Reports and moderation decisions - until the reported content or the reporter’s account is deleted.
Database backups at our provider - up to a few days, after which the data also disappears from backups.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You have the right to:
access your data and obtain a copy - download it in the settings (JSON export);
rectification - you can correct most data yourself in the settings and profile;
erasure - delete your account in the settings;
restriction of processing;
data portability (the same JSON export);
object to processing based on legitimate interest;
withdraw consent at any time - without affecting the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal;
lodge a complaint with the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (UODO, ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warsaw, Poland, https://uodo.gov.pl).
For other requests write to kontakt@cookivo.pl. We reply without undue delay, at the latest within one month.

sections.title: Cookies and browser storage
body: We only use technologies that are strictly necessary for the service:
a session cookie (secure, not accessible to scripts, valid for up to 30 days) - keeps you signed in;
browser storage (localStorage) - remembers your theme, language and the page to return to after sign-up.

We use no analytics or advertising cookies and load no third-party scripts - fonts and icons are served from our own server. That is why we do not ask for cookie consent: strictly necessary technologies do not require it.

sections.title: Security
body: Passwords are stored as Argon2id hashes, connections are encrypted (HTTPS), the session is kept in a cookie scripts cannot read, and after several failed sign-in attempts the account is temporarily locked. We never ask for your password by email.
If a personal data breach occurs that may put your rights at risk, we will notify the President of UODO within 72 hours and - where required - inform you without undue delay.

sections.title: Age
body: You must be at least 16 to create an account. Younger people can be included in a household as people without an account, added by a parent or guardian.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
body: We will tell you about significant changes in the service after you sign in. The current version and its effective date are at the top of this page; your consent history is in the settings.

termsDoc.title: Terms of service
termsDoc.intro: These terms set out the rules for using Cookivo at cookivo.pl - services provided electronically within the meaning of the Polish Act of 18 July 2002 on providing services by electronic means. The Polish version is the binding one.

sections.title: Service provider and contact
body: The service provider is Patryk Ożóg, running the service as a private individual. Contact: kontakt@cookivo.pl.
The same address is the point of contact for users and authorities within the meaning of Articles 11 and 12 of the Digital Services Act (DSA). We communicate in Polish and English.
The service charges no fees for its use.

sections.title: Services
body: without an account: browsing public recipes and the ingredient database;

with an account: creating recipes (private, household or public) with photos, ratings and comments, a nutrition profile with a needs calculator, a meal planner, pantry, shopping lists, price lists and cost estimates, households, friend groups (shared recipes; the group owner approves new people) and reporting content.
Ingredient nutrition values come from USDA FoodData Central and the ANSES Ciqual 2025 table (Licence Ouverte 2.0) - the source is shown for each ingredient.

sections.title: Technical requirements and risks
body: You need a device with internet access, an up-to-date browser (e.g. Chrome, Firefox, Safari or Edge) with JavaScript and cookies enabled and - to create an account - an active email address.
Using the internet carries common risks such as malware or phishing. We never ask for your password by email - sign in only at cookivo.pl.

sections.title: Account
body: You must be at least 16 to create an account.
The contract for the account is concluded when the account is created, for an indefinite period.
The account is personal - do not share it and keep your password confidential.
You can terminate the contract at any time by deleting your account in the settings.
We may terminate the contract or block the account for a serious or repeated breach of these terms - under the rules in "Reports and moderation".

sections.title: Rules of use
body: It is prohibited to publish content that is:
illegal, including content infringing copyright or image rights;
offensive, vulgar, or inciting hatred or violence;
advertising or spam;
containing other people’s personal data without their consent;
presented as medical advice or encouraging behaviour that endangers health.
It is also prohibited to bypass security measures, scrape the service on a large scale or disrupt its operation.

sections.title: Your content and licence
body: You keep the rights to your recipes and photos. By publishing content you confirm that you hold the rights to it (e.g. you took the photo yourself) and that people shown in photos agreed to publication.

By making a recipe public (with photos, a rating or a comment) you grant the service provider a free, non-exclusive, worldwide licence to store, reproduce and make that content available in the service to the extent needed for it to operate (including backups). Other users may create their own private variants based on a public recipe.

The licence for public recipes continues after you delete your account - the recipe stays on the site without your name (anonymously) so that other people’s plans and variants keep working. If you do not want that, make the recipe private or delete it before deleting your account. Private content, household and group recipes and ratings are deleted with the account - a household or group recipe stays (without your name) only if others use it as an ingredient of their recipes.

sections.title: Reports and moderation
body: You can report content you consider illegal or contrary to these terms with the "Report" button on a recipe, review or profile, or by email to kontakt@cookivo.pl (identify the content, explain why and give your contact details). We handle reports without undue delay, and you can see the status of your reports in the settings.
After reports from 3 different people, content is automatically hidden until a moderator decides.
Possible decisions: keeping the content, hiding it, hiding the username, or a temporary or permanent account block.
The author receives a statement of reasons: what we did, why, on what basis and whether the decision was automated.
You can appeal a decision within 6 months by writing to kontakt@cookivo.pl. Appeals are reviewed by a person, not an automated system.
You may also use a certified out-of-court dispute settlement body (Art. 21 DSA) or go to court.
Persistently sending manifestly unfounded reports breaches these terms and may lead to an account block.

sections.title: Health and nutrition values
body: Calculations of calories, macronutrients, portions and costs are indicative and do not replace advice from a doctor or dietitian. User recipes are not reviewed by professionals.

We mark allergens of database ingredients to the best of our knowledge, but product composition differs between manufacturers - if you have an allergy, always check the label. Reading a recipe or receipt from photos and the assistant's suggestions (plans, recipes, recipe versions) are prepared by an AI model and may contain mistakes - check the draft before saving, especially amounts, ingredients, allergens and prices.

sections.title: Liability
body: We take care to keep the service running, but technical interruptions are possible, especially during updates. Users are responsible for the content they publish; once we receive credible information that content is illegal, we block it promptly.
Nothing in these terms limits the rights consumers have under mandatory law.

sections.title: Complaints
body: Send complaints about how the service works to kontakt@cookivo.pl - describe the problem and give your account email address. We will reply within 14 days.
As a consumer in Poland you can also get free help from a municipal or district consumer ombudsman or the Voivodeship Inspectorate of Trade Inspection.

sections.title: Changes to the terms
body: We may change these terms for important reasons: changes in law, new features or security. We will inform you in the service after you sign in. Changes that are unfavourable to users will be announced at least 14 days before they take effect, unless they result from law or concern security; changes that only add new, optional features may take effect on the day they are announced. If you do not accept the changes, you can delete your account at any time.

sections.title: Final provisions
body: These terms are governed by Polish law; this does not deprive consumers of the protection given by the mandatory laws of their country of residence. The terms are available free of charge on this page - you can save or print them.
